Some opinions and suggestions (of mine, i'm not a doctor so take what i say with a grain of salt):

If you are old you should stay inside and limit your in-person contacts. Prefer internet contacts (chats, emails, phone calls, video calls) whenever possible. Keep in mind that this is only temporary while the virus is in its epidemic phase.

If you have children and the schools in your country are closed (like here in Italy) tell them to stay in touch with their friends through internet (PCs, tablets, smartphones), limiting their time online is not a good idea now. Children are not as much affected as adults are and they should be fine, but they are good carriers of the virus, staying in touch with their friends will make them feel less lonely and less scared. IF the virus is NOT known to be spreading in your community it SHOULD be ok to let them visit their friends or have lunch/dinner with them.

There are no real medicines you can take to prevent this illness, but you can boost up your natural defenses by resting at least 8 hours per night (or taking naps) and by adding some vitamin D to your diet each day (do NOT exaggerate: it is useless because our body can not process too much vitamin D and it is actually possible to overdose on it).

Don't panic, there is no reason to do so, but use your brain and avoid situations where you could get infected. The goal here is to slow down the virus enough to not overflow the hospitals with sick people. This is pretty much all we can do right now.
